----------------------------------
     INSTALL: Squarespace > Pages > [store page, e.g. photo-workshops-uk]
              > Settings (gear) > Advanced > Page Header Code Injection
              Paste this entire block. Save.
     SCOPE:   Cascades to all product detail pages under /photo-workshops-uk/.
              No-ops on the hub listing page, 0-variant products, and in the
              Squarespace editor.
     ROLLBACK: Delete this block from the header injection. Done.
     DATA:    Reads ONLY existing sources - no new infrastructure:
              1. https://schema.alanranger.com/products-manifest.json
              2. The product's hosted schema JSON (rating + reviews)
              3. The page's own ?format=json (live variants/prices/stock)
                 -> with fix18 fallback to Static.SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT.product
     ================================================================= -->
